title: Nothing beats French pressed coffee!
text:
Nothing beats French pressed coffee!. Arrived fast. Great looking, well made French press. I wanted really good fresh coffee- I am so tired of pods. I was not didappointed! This delivered. Made the best coffee- and it is worth the wait.
Thumbs up. 5 stars.

product_metadata.title: Ritual French Coffee Press (New 2019 Version), Bamboo Wood, Borosilicate Glass, and Stainless Steel, Coffee & Tea Maker with Bonus Filter 36oz/1000ml
features: #IMPROVED 2019! We added a silicon barrier for the bottom of the lid to prevent bamboo from warping.
#PURE COFFEE: A dual layer precision filter designed by coffee masters ensures you drink smooth coffee without the grounds.
#BEAUTIFUL: Our Unique design lets you watch the kaleidoscope of your coffee and tea brew without plastic in the way.
#QUALITY: A solid stainless steel structure and sustainable bamboo lid and handle make this french press last a lifetime.
#CUSTOMER SATISFACTION: This french press is made to last you the rest of your life and look good doing it or we'll replace it.

details.Included Components: Solid Glass Body, Precision Coffee Filter, Bamboo Handle and Lid, Stainless Steel Frame
